title: 反思与收获

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：What I took away from that experience was [lesson learned].
sentenceFrames.usage: 直接说出你从一件事中学到了什么。"Takeaway" 是口语里最常用的"收获"。
sentenceFrames.example: What I took away from that whole mess was that you can't control what happens to you — you can only control how you respond.
substitutions: 从一次失败的经历**：What I took away from that experience was _____.
从一段关系中**：What I took away from that relationship was _____.
从学英语的过程中**：What I took away from learning English was _____.
你的真实收获：What I took away from _____ was _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：If I could go back, I would [what you'd do differently]. Not because [reason], but because [deeper reason].
sentenceFrames.usage: 表达"如果能重来"——但不只是表面的后悔，而是更深层的反思。
sentenceFrames.example: If I could go back, I would tell myself to speak up more. Not because my ideas were better than anyone else's, but because staying silent didn't protect me — it just made me invisible.
substitutions: 关于大学时期：If I could go back, I would _____. Not because _____, but because _____.
关于职业选择：If I could go back, I would _____. Not because _____, but because _____.
关于人际关系：If I could go back, I would _____. Not because _____, but because _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：It taught me that [universal truth / personal principle].
sentenceFrames.usage: 故事结尾的"升华"——从具体的事件提炼出一个普遍的道理。
sentenceFrames.example: It taught me that courage isn't the absence of fear — it's being terrified and doing it anyway.
substitutions: 一次旅行** 教会你：It taught me that _____.
一次失败** 教会你：It taught me that _____.
一个你不喜欢但必须做的事** 教会你：It taught me that _____.
你最近学到的一件事：It taught me that _____.
